decisions.rationale: This matches the accepted idea's required local technology and infrastructure constraints.
decisions.statement: Use .NET/C#, ASP.NET Core, Postgres, and Docker Compose as the implementation baseline.

decisions.rationale: The operation-oriented API benefits from cohesive slices and avoids abstractions that obscure task behavior.
decisions.statement: Use Vertical Slice Architecture with a minimal shared kernel and no generic Controller, Service, or Repository layers.

decisions.rationale: Persistence behavior and restart durability are core product outcomes and cannot be established by mocks or in-memory storage alone.
decisions.statement: Use real Postgres for integration tests and execute them in isolated, serial runs.

decisions.rationale: This supports reproducible local setup without committing credentials or exposing them through the API.
decisions.statement: Configure the database through TODO_DB_CONNECTION, documenting only a safe local default.

decisions.rationale: The accepted idea explicitly excludes frontend, identity, cloud or production deployment, migration, and regulated-data claims.
decisions.statement: Limit the product to greenfield local development and test use.

goals.statement: Deliver a cohesive JSON HTTP API for creating, listing, filtering, completing, editing, and removing tasks.
Persist task id, title, and status in local Postgres and preserve them across API-only restarts.
Make local startup and verification reproducible, including automatic schema initialization and real HTTP/Postgres integration tests.
Keep the implementation maintainable through Vertical Slice Architecture, minimal shared code, input validation, and sanitized dependency failures.

nonGoals: Users, authentication, authorization, or multi-tenant behavior
Cloud, production, or deployment operational support

risks.description: Local Postgres startup timing or connection configuration may make startup and tests flaky.
risks.mitigation: Use Docker Compose health/readiness checks, bounded retry behavior, a persistent volume, and a documented TODO_DB_CONNECTION default; keep integration tests isolated and serial.

risks.description: Inconsistent validation or error payloads could make HTTP clients and tests depend on implementation details.
risks.mitigation: Define the JSON and Problem Details contract up front and cover success, invalid input, missing task, and dependency-failure cases in endpoint tests.

risks.description: Over-generalized abstractions could dilute vertical-slice cohesion and increase maintenance cost.
risks.mitigation: Keep each operation's request handling, validation, persistence interaction, and response mapping close to its slice; extract only genuinely shared kernel concerns.

risks.description: Configuration or database failures could accidentally disclose credentials or internal failure details.
risks.mitigation: Log and return sanitized errors, redact connection secrets, and test that external responses never contain credentials, stack traces, or provider internals.

scope: A .NET/C# ASP.NET Core Web API for unauthenticated local HTTP clients
Six task operations: create, query/list, filter, complete, edit, and remove
Stable JSON responses and Problem Details responses for validation and sanitized failures
Postgres persistence with one Docker Compose local Postgres service and a persistent volume
Automatic local schema initialization and connection configuration through TODO_DB_CONNECTION with a documented local default
Vertical Slice Architecture with a minimal shared kernel and no generic Controller, Service, or Repository layers
Pure unit tests plus isolated, serial integration tests using real Postgres and real HTTP

successMetrics.measure: Supported task-management operations that have documented request, response, and Problem Details behavior
successMetrics.target: 6 of 6 operations implemented and covered by contract-level tests

successMetrics.measure: Task records retained after stopping and restarting only the API process while Postgres remains available
successMetrics.target: 100% of verification runs retain id, title, and status for previously created tasks

successMetrics.measure: Clean local environment verification flow using Docker Compose and the documented database connection configuration
successMetrics.target: One command or documented command sequence passes pure unit tests and isolated serial HTTP/Postgres integration tests

successMetrics.measure: Failure and validation cases exposed to clients without internal details
successMetrics.target: All invalid-input and dependency-failure tests return stable Problem Details responses with no credentials, stack traces, or internal diagnostics

vision: Give local unauthenticated HTTP clients a dependable Todo API whose task data survives API-only restarts and whose behavior can be verified reproducibly against real Postgres.
